title: Competition-Adaptive Reliability Mixture

predecessor_evidence.M2.5_specialist_audit: SPECIALIST TRADEOFF PRESENT (m0: -0.0089 CI entirely < 0; m8: +0.0258 CI entirely > 0; 3 seeds, paired image-cluster bootstrap 5000 reps)
predecessor_evidence.LCR_v1: M1 NO-GO and M2 NO-GO stay frozen as a negative result; this amendment is NOT an LCR v1 modification

methodological_boundary.b0_forbidden_use: B0 mixture performance must never be presented as confirmatory method evidence
methodological_boundary.freeze_rule: all method structures, metrics and thresholds are frozen before the B1/B2 mixture run (see freeze_point)

experts.rule: expert structures are never modified; expert weights stay frozen while fitting the mixers

competition_index.cdf: per backbone; empirical CDF fitted on that backbone's reliability_train m={0,2,4} rows only
competition_index.index: A = (u1 + u2 + u3) / 3, A in [0, 1]; larger A = stronger local competition
competition_index.frozen: this formula is frozen; no search over the three feature weights

adaptive_mix.note: implementation may parameterise beta = softplus(theta); beta >= 0 is mandatory

static_mix.equation: p_static = (1 - c) p_R + c p_C with c in [0, 1]
static_mix.note: most important mechanistic control: if AdaptiveMix ~ StaticMix, competition adaptation itself has no value

fitting.regime_weight: L = (1/3) (L_m0 + L_m2 + L_m4); equal weight per regime, never per-sample-count

primary_comparison: AdaptiveMix vs StaticMix (does competition-dependent adaptation add value beyond a plain ensemble?)

confirmatory_gates.status: DRAFT — frozen as Amendment V2-M3.1 after B0; never modified from B0 test results
confirmatory_gates.selective_support: at least one of {Macro E-AURC improves >= 3%, Macro RER@50 gain >= 1pp} versus StaticMix; otherwise the result is labelled AUROC-ONLY METHOD SIGNAL

diagnostics.oracle_regret: Oracle_m = max(AUROC_R(m), AUROC_C(m)); Regret_m = Oracle_m - AUROC_method(m); report mean and max regret; diagnostic only, never a training objective
diagnostics.competition_index_report: per m: A mean, A median, A p10/p90, alpha mean, alpha median; expected (not gated): A/alpha generally increase with m
diagnostics.disagreement_exclusion: |p_R - p_C| does not increase monotonically with m (M2.5) and is never a gate input for AdaptiveMix v1
diagnostics.calibration_report: ECE / Brier / NLL are reported; if AUROC improves while calibration clearly degrades this must be recorded honestly
diagnostics.grounding_invariance: raw grounding scores, argmax and accuracy stay unchanged; the mixture only changes the reliability estimate

parameter_budget.note: record total parameters; no hidden layer may be added

b0_plan.experts: frozen M1/M2 artifacts of the B0 backbone

freeze_point: after B0: no modification of the competition index, the CDF transform, the three input features, the mixing equation, the loss, the expert definitions, the static baseline, the metrics or the cross-backbone gates may be driven by B0 test mixture results

b1_b2_expert_preparation.E_random: reuse the V2-G random E1b artifacts (restore, never retrain if an artifact exists)
b1_b2_expert_preparation.E_curriculum: train with the identical B0 M2 protocol: m={0,2,4} balanced curriculum, same C grid, normalisation and split
b1_b2_expert_preparation.per_backbone: CDF from the backbone's own reliability_train; mixer fitted on the backbone's own reliability_tune; identical architecture and formula; no backbone-specific redesign
b1_b2_expert_preparation.frozen_test: same frozen K=10 severity cohort (m in {0,2,4,8}); all models share exactly the same rows

amendment_note: approved by the preregistered M2.5 specialisation finding (SPECIALIST TRADEOFF PRESENT); new method amendment, not an LCR v1 patch
